content.text: I am NOT happy about this. The hair dryer stopped working after a few uses, that is a fault, not me changing my mind. Thirty days is completely unfair when the thing broke and I had no way of knowing it would die that fast. I do not want a replacement, I want my money back. Can you please pass this to someone with the authority to review it, a supervisor or whoever decides these things?
Customer wants escalation. Policy: handoff to human when customer asks for a human. So we must handoff.
